message.content:
You are building a differential-test corpus for a byte-exact JavaScript reimplementation of this Python program:

    import yaml, argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--a', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(yaml.dump(yaml.safe_load(args.a), default_style='|'))

Your assigned category is "collections-flow":
Flow collections: [] and {} nested arbitrarily, flow inside block and block inside flow contexts, trailing commas, empty flow collections, flow entries with missing values ({a}), flow pairs ([a: b]), single-pair mappings inside sequences, adjacent-value syntax, and deeply nested flow.

TASK: write a Node ESM script at /workspace/probe/corpus/gen_collections-flow.mjs that writes AT LEAST 60 distinct test-case files into /workspace/probe/corpus/collections-flow/ named 001.txt, 002.txt, ... Each file's ENTIRE byte content is one value for the --a argument (a YAML document, possibly multi-line, possibly with a trailing newline).

Rules:
- Use only: import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
- Build the cases as a plain JS array of strings, then write them out. Use \n, \t, \u.... escapes in the JS source rather than literal control characters.
- Cases must be DISTINCT from one another and must actually exercise your category. Prefer many small focused cases over a few large ones. Include obvious/common forms as well as pathological ones.
- Do NOT include a case whose text starts with "-" unless it also contains a space before any newline (argparse would swallow it as an option flag). Concretely: if the string starts with "-", make sure the FIRST line contains a space, e.g. "- a" is fine, "---" alone is not.
- Some cases SHOULD be invalid YAML if your category calls for it; that is expected and useful.
- Avoid the NUL character.

Then RUN your script with: cd /workspace/probe/corpus && node gen_collections-flow.mjs
Then sanity-check that the files exist and a few of them produce sensible behaviour from the reference binary, e.g.:
    /workspace/dataset/test14_executable --a "$(cat /workspace/probe/corpus/collections-flow/001.txt)"
(that shell form mangles trailing newlines, it is only a smoke test).

Do not modify anything outside /workspace/probe/corpus/. Do not read or write /output.

Return ONLY a one-line summary: the category key and the number of case files written.

import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';

const OUT = '/workspace/probe/corpus/collections-flow';

const cases = [
  // --- empty flow collections ---
  '[]',
  '{}',
  '[ ]',
  '{ }',
  '[]\n',
  '{}\n',
  '[  ]  ',
  '- []\n- {}\n',

  // --- basic flow sequences / mappings ---
  '[a, b, c]',
  '[1, 2, 3]',
  '{a: 1, b: 2}',
  '{a: b}',
  '[a]',
  '{ a : b }',
  '[ a , b ]',
  '[a,b,c]',
  '{a: 1,b: 2}',

  // --- trailing commas ---
  '[a,]',
  '[a, b,]',
  '{a: 1,}',
  '{a: 1, b: 2,}',
  '[[a,],]',
  '{a: [1,], b: {c: 2,},}',
  '[a, b, ]',
  '{a: b, }',

  // --- flow entries with missing values ---
  '{a}',
  '{a, b}',
  '{a, b, c}',
  '{a, b: c}',
  '{a: b, c}',
  '{a: }',
  '{a: , b: c}',
  '{a:}',
  '{"a":}',
  '[a: ]',

  // --- explicit key indicators in flow ---
  '{? a : b}',
  '{? a}',
  '[? a : b]',
  '[? a]',
  '{? a : b, ? c : d}',

  // --- flow pairs inside sequences ---
  '[a: b]',
  '[a: b, c: d]',
  '[a: b, c]',
  '[c, a: b]',
  '[{a: b}, c: d]',
  '[a: b, a: c]',
  '[a: [1, 2]]',
  '[a: {b: c}]',

  // --- single-pair mappings inside block sequences ---
  '- a: b\n- c: d\n',
  '- {a: b, c: d}\n- {e: f}\n',
  '- [a: b]\n- [c: d]\n',
  '- {x: y}',

  // --- adjacent value syntax (JSON-like, no space after colon) ---
  '{"a":b}',
  '{"a":"b","c":"d"}',
  '["a":b]',
  '[{"k":"v"}]',
  '{"a":[1,2],"b":{"c":3}}',
  '{a:b}',
  '[a:b]',
  '[a:b, c:d]',

  // --- flow inside block ---
  'a: [1, 2]',
  'a: {b: c}',
  'a: [1, 2]\nb: {c: d}\n',
  '- [1, 2]\n- {k: v}\n',
  'outer:\n  inner: [a, {b: [c]}]\n',
  'a:\n- [1]\n- {2: 3}\n',
  'k: []\nj: {}\n',

  // --- multi-line flow collections ---
  'a: [\n  1,\n  2\n]',
  'key: [\n  a,\n  b,\n]\n',
  'map: {\n  a: 1,\n  b: 2\n}\n',
  '[a,\n b,\n c]',
  '[a,\n [b,\n  c]]',
  '{\n  a: 1,\n  b: [\n    2,\n    3\n  ]\n}\n',
  '[\n]',
  '{\n}',
  '[a\n, b]',
  '[a ,\n b]',

  // --- deeply nested flow ---
  '[[]]',
  '[{}]',
  '{a: {}}',
  '{a: []}',
  '[[[[[]]]]]',
  '[[1, 2], [3, 4]]',
  '[{a: 1}, {b: 2}]',
  '{a: {b: {c: {d: e}}}}',
  '{a: [1, [2, [3, [4]]]]}',
  '[{a: [{b: [c]}]}]',
  '[ [ [ ] , [ ] ] ]',
  '[' .repeat(30) + 'x' + ']'.repeat(30),
  '{a: '.repeat(20) + 'z' + '}'.repeat(20),
  '[{a: [{a: [{a: []}]}]}]',
  '[[[a, [b, [c, [d]]]]]]',

  // --- tags on flow collections ---
  '!!seq [a, b]',
  '!!map {a: b}',
  '!!set {a, b}',
  '!!omap [a: 1, b: 2]',
  '!!pairs [a: 1, a: 2]',
  '[!!str 1, !!int "2"]',
  '{!!str a: !!int 3}',
  '!!seq []',
  '!!map {}',

  // --- anchors / aliases in flow ---
  '[&x a, *x]',
  '{a: &x [1, 2], b: *x}',
  '[&s [1], *s]',
  '{&k a: b}',

  // --- quoting / special characters inside flow ---
  '["a, b", c]',
  "['[a]', b]",
  '{"a: b": c}',
  '["", \'\']',
  '{"": ""}',
  '[a\\, b]',
  '["a\\nb", c]',
  '[\'a{b}c\', "d[e]f"]',

  // --- comments around flow ---
  '[a, # c\n b]',
  '[a, b] # trailing',
  '{a: 1} # trailing\n',
  '# lead\n[a, b]\n',

  // --- nulls / bools / numbers in flow ---
  '[null, true, false, ~]',
  '{null: a, true: b}',
  '[, ]'.replace(', ', ' , '),
  '{a: null, b: ~, c: }',

  // --- duplicate keys in flow ---
  '{a: b, a: c}',
  '{a: 1, a: 2, a: 3}',

  // --- document markers with flow ---
  '--- [a, b]\n',
  '--- {a: b}\n...\n',
  '---\n[a, b]\n',

  // --- pathological / invalid ---
  '[a',
  '{a: b',
  '[a]]',
  '{a: b}}',
  '[}',
  '{]',
  '[,]',
  '{,}',
  '[a,,b]',
  '{:a}',
  '[: b]',
  '[- a]',
  '[a\n- b]',
  '{a: b\n- c}',
  '[a, b]: c',
  '{a: b}: c',
  '{[a]: b}',
  '{{}: a}',
  '[a, b] [c]',
  '{a: b} {c: d}',
  '[a: b: c]',
  '{a: b: c}',
  '[\ta,\tb ]',
  '{\ta: b}',
  '[a}',
  '{a: b]',
  '[[a], {b}',
  '[a, ? b : c, d]',
  '? [a]\n: b\n',
  '[]: x\n',
  '{}: x\n',
];

const seen = new Set();
const uniq = [];
for (const c of cases) {
  if (seen.has(c)) continue;
  seen.add(c);
  uniq.push(c);
}

mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
uniq.forEach((c, i) => {
  const name = String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0') + '.txt';
  writeFileSync(OUT + '/' + name, c);
});
writeFileSync(OUT + '/../collections-flow.count', String(uniq.length) + '\n');
